verdicts.reason: A: the card fills the whole canvas, so the city-skyline image is almost entirely lost apart from a few star pixels. The 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, which breaks the reading order, and there is a large dead gap above the CTA. Still, the left edge is consistent and the hierarchy is clean. B: the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow is moved below the body copy and enlarged into a wide-tracked cyan line that competes with the headline. The tiny right-aligned logo sits on an arbitrary axis, the centred CTA clashes with the left-aligned text, the headline and body are cramped together, and the card runs into a cropped city strip at the bottom that looks like an accident.
